description: Aggressor-side order flow: buy and sell volume separated by who crossed the spread, delta, the footprint by price level, the point of control, and absorption or stacked imbalance. Measured from the venue aggressor tag, not inferred from bar direction — use it when the question is who is being aggressive, which candles cannot answer. For one candle pass candleTime, which reads exactly that bar; otherwise it reads the last `minutes`. Report coveredMinutes, not the minutes asked for.

bucketSize.description: Price bucket width. Omit unless matching a footprint on screen.

candleTime.description: A bar open time, s or ms: reads that whole candle.

includeSignals.description: Absorption and stacked imbalance. Default true.

timeframe.description: With candleTime. Defaults to the chart timeframe.

name: orderflow_read
